delegation.owner_message: 好，那健保新版也改成自動更新
delegation.context: After TFDA weekly updates became automatic, the owner asked for new NHI versions to be checked and published the same way instead of waiting for an owner review.

reviewer_note: Automated checks run by the daily schedule under the owner's delegation; no person or AI reads each new version.

NHI-R1-SOURCE.purpose: The new raw artifact comes from the confirmed NHI dataset.
checklist: Metadata publisherOID, identifier and license code equal the confirmed values.
The CSV was fetched over HTTPS from an allowlisted info.nhi.gov.tw resource URL discovered from the data.gov.tw metadata.
fetch.json is canonical and its artifact size and SHA-256 match the stored raw CSV.

NHI-R1-SCHEMA.purpose: The new version keeps the approved nhi-7-v1 schema and changed by an ordinary amount.
checklist: The header has the seven approved columns in order and every row passes the strict parser.
Row count and distinct code count each changed by at most 10 percent from the serving version.
The blank rate of the English item name rose by at most 2 percentage points.
At least 10 golden cases chosen and parsed by an independent parser pass against the new raw CSV.
Before the pointer switches, an independent parser compares every curated row with the raw CSV: row numbers, row hashes, raw values, points and laboratory scope status.

PUB-R1-OWNER.purpose: A version that passes every automated check may replace the served version on the local MCP runtime.
checklist: Only an installed distribution may publish.
A version that fails any check is not published; the approved version keeps serving and is marked as having a newer candidate.
Codes without an approved laboratory scope rule stay review_pending and are listed in the owner email.
The owner is emailed after each automatic publish and after each held-back version.
Review records name the reviewer as automated-check:nhi-auto-update, never as a person or as the owner.
GitHub Release download bundles are not changed by this protocol.

golden_cases.selection: Rows matching the fixed coverage list first, then evenly spaced rows until at least 10 cases exist.
golden_cases.comparison: Compare each expected value, row number and row hash with an independent parse of the raw CSV.
